blockers.detail: Two counterhistories can yield the same final anchored geometry: uppermark first then planned baseline, or baseline first then uppermark. No temporal overlap relation is required by the five gates. Even demonstrated baseline-before-upper order would not by itself distinguish normal multipart construction from revising a previously completed expression. The actual marks are not assigned to either history.

The source comments used for selecting the loci already allege an addition/afterwards. A subsequent pass on spatial separation, ink density or baseline coherence does not independently verify that chronological interpretation. Ink darkness alone is not a supplied temporal ordering. No actual glyph identity, correction intent or meaning is established.

all_of.detail: An independently interpretable temporal cue or distinct physical states at a precisely owned locus. Establishing local stroke order and establishing revision of a completed expression are separate claims. Another look at the same geometry, an asserted reading or the original afterwards-comment is not enough.
